issues.on_page: Taxes: Other includes Visitor Promotion Fund 36,427 + Visitor Improvement Fund 36,427 = 72,854 (p16); 911 funds 23,286 + 136 + 50,600 (pp18-19)
issues.issue: About 72,854 of 'Taxes: Other' sits in the visitor promotion and improvement funds (county lodging tax). It is left in other taxes, while the sister report CO12 (Butler County) splits the same kind of line into lodging tax. The page does not say 'lodging', so this is a judgment call (also applies to detail[50]).

The extractor rules list noxious weed control under natural resources/conservation. It is printed under Public Works, so streets/highways is defensible, but CO12 uses natural resources/conservation for the same line.
Investments are reported separately on the balance statement, but ending_investments is left null. The rules ask for it to be filled as an informational figure, and CO12 fills it.
